steps.intro: Welcome to the GAFS A-Watch Student portal.
steps.login: Sign in with your student email and password.
steps.dashboard: Your dashboard shows your personal attendance history.
steps.scan: Open Scan QR and point your phone camera at the session QR code shown by your teacher.
steps.scan.done: Attendance is recorded. Check your dashboard for the updated status.
steps.profile: Your profile shows your account information.
